title: Patch: holding a Mythic or full-art card on a phone shows its text, not only its art
notes: On touch devices (phones and tablets), pressing and holding a Mythic card or any card wearing a full-art level opens its inspect sheet or card detail view with its full rules text, glossary, and metadata, rather than directly opening the full-screen art view. The full-screen art view remains reachable via the Full screen button in that text view, while desktop click-and-hold continues to open the full-screen art view directly (R3893000).

player.title: Holding a Mythic or full-art card on a phone shows its text
changes: On a touch screen, holding a Mythic or full-art card opens its inspect sheet or detail view with its full text; its full-screen art view remains reachable from there.
